title: The point guard job (v5)
blueprint: Value / belief post: 'PG is glorified' → it's the hardest job. Bank: December (evergreen)
goal: Three questions every point guard has to answer, each shown with one full rep from the Monday drill (start on the right, 1v1 down the middle, finish or hand-off)
cta: Send this to your point guard
hooks: Everyone wants to be the point guard. Ball in your hands, running the show.
Think you're a point guard because you dribble the most?
Point guard is the most glorified spot on the floor. It's also the hardest.
open_loop: It comes down to three questions.
close_loop: Most players only train the first two. Number three is the job.

shots.vo: Everyone wants to be the point guard. Ball in your hands, running the show.
shots.text: Everyone wants to be the point guard

shots.vo: and you cough it up, with everyone watching.
Your team's waiting on you to lead.
That's the part nobody shows you.
It comes down to three questions. One: can you protect the ball and handle pressure?
Two: can you break down your player and get to your spot?
shots.text: 2 · Break down your player, get to your spot

shots.vo: Three: can you initiate the offence and make plays under pressure? Into the hand-off, read it, make the right play.
shots.text: 3 · Initiate the offence & make the play

shots.vo: Most only train the first two. Three is the job.

end_card.main: Send this to your point guard

structure: Jason's opener in full (red shorts downhill, moves, jump shot over blue, walk back) → pressure and turnover clips → the three points → close on the blow-by layup (a make)
